يصطلقوا (form VIII)

# يُصْطَلَقُوا (yuṣṭalaqū) /jusˤ.tˤa.la.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
